{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp and chainstatemanager_opts.h are mechanical updates accommodating the validation queue rather than kernel API or boundary work.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Kernel files are only modified to adapt initialization options to the new validation worker queue."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not alter mempool acceptance, policy, or data structures.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Validation changes do not touch transaction mempool policies or validation rules."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Minor adaptations in src/node/block_template_manager.cpp and src/rpc/mining.cpp follow from the validation changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mining template generation logic is not substantively modified beyond accommodating changes to validation."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes src/net_processing.cpp and src/test/peerman_tests.cpp to decouple P2P message handling from block validation and reduce cs_main contention.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Decoupling block processing substantially resolves message processing stalls and latency spikes during block reception. PR benchmarks show ping/pong latency dropped 98% from 41.8 ms to 0.77 ms and block-serving latency decreased by up to 45%."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/mining.cpp only to adapt to internal validation interface updates.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change RPC endpoints, arguments, or behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds unit and fuzz test coverage specifically testing peerman and validation queues.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests pin the behavior of the newly added validation queue and net processing components rather than modifying the test framework itself."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp solely for startup and shutdown wiring of the new validation queue.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change does not affect general node utilities or shared primitives."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Introduces src/validation_queue.cpp and modifies src/validation.cpp to asynchronously process block persistence and chain activation in ChainstateManager.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Restructures how block persistence and chain activation are queued and executed within ChainstateManager. Benchmarks demonstrate a ~5% total IBD time reduction alongside major concurrency improvements."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 2,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
